description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractModelAction' and multiple nested classes representing different action models for a widget framework in Apache OFBiz. It includes methods for creating instances from XML elements, executing actions, and managing various widget-related operations such as entity queries, service calls, property setting, and scripting.

classes.name: AbstractModelAction
classes.description: Abstract base class for widget action models, representing an immutable XML element. Provides factory methods for creating specific action instances and executing sub-actions. Contains nested classes for different action types such as entity queries, property setting, scripting, and service invocation.

classes.name: EntityAnd
classes.description: Models the <entity-and> XML element, performs a combined entity query using ByAndFinder.

classes.name: EntityCondition
classes.description: Models the <entity-condition> XML element, performs an entity query using ByConditionFinder.

classes.name: EntityOne
classes.description: Models the <entity-one> XML element, performs a primary key entity lookup.

classes.name: GetRelated
classes.description: Models the <get-related> XML element, retrieves related entities based on a relation.

classes.name: GetRelatedOne
classes.description: Models the <get-related-one> XML element, retrieves a single related entity.

classes.name: PropertyMap
classes.description: Models the <property-map> XML element, manages resource bundle properties.

classes.name: PropertyToField
classes.description: Models the <property-to-field> XML element, maps properties to widget fields.

classes.name: Script
classes.description: Models the <script> XML element, executes scripts or simple methods.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Models the <service> XML element, invokes a service and stores results.

classes.name: SetField
classes.description: Models the <set> XML element, sets widget fields or session/application attributes.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a specific ModelAction instance based on the XML node name.

methods.name: readSubActions
methods.description: Reads and constructs a list of sub-actions from XML child elements.

methods.name: runSubActions
methods.description: Executes a list of sub-actions within a given context.
